questions.stem: In how many different ways can the letters of the word BANANA be arranged?
questions.explanation:
BANANA has 6 letters, but they are not all distinct:
$$B \times 1, \quad A \times 3, \quad N \times 2.$$

For a word with repeated letters the count is
$$\frac{n!}{p!\,q!\cdots} = \frac{6!}{3!\,2!}.$$

$$= \frac{720}{6 \times 2} = \frac{720}{12} = \mathbf{60}.$$

*(Treating all six letters as distinct would give $6! = 720$ — option 4, the trap.)*
